name: Bowhill Adventure Playground
description: Adventure playground in the grounds of Bowhill House, three miles west of Selkirk on the A708, with two zip wires, two slides, a big wooden fort, swings and musical instruments. The grounds open at weekends in May and September and daily from June to August.
fee: Grounds and adventure playground: £7 adult, £5 child, under-3s free. Historic Houses members get in free (book a free ticket online).
